# Push

**Motion › Push Slide** · v1.0.0 · 24 frames at 30 fps (8–60)

The new scene pushes the old one out of frame.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/push@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Next item in a sequence
- Changing place or topic
- Carousels and lists

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import push from './transitions/05-motion/push-slide/push';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(push, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 24 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | enum | `"left"` | `left` · `right` · `up` · `down` | Direction the motion travels. |
| `curve` | enum | `"quint"` | `cubic` · `quint` · `expo` | Ease curve; expo is the snappiest. |
